content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for Chennai Port Authority Materials Manager (Dy. HOD) Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.chennaiport.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 03-10-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Chennai Port Authority Materials Manager (Dy. HOD) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to receive the application for the Chennai Port Authority Materials Manager (Dy. HOD) recruitment is 03 October 2026. Ensure your application reaches the authority before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Materials Manager post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Degree in Electrical/Mechanical Engineering or an equivalent qualification from a recognized university, along with prescribed experience in Materials Management.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Materials Manager position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Materials Manager (Dy. HOD) post will receive a salary in the range of Rs. 80,000 to Rs. 2,20,000 per month.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for this government job?
faq.answer: The application process for this recruitment is offline. You need to download the application form from the official website, fill it correctly, and send it along with required documents to the specified address before the last date.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment. Candidates can apply without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Materials Manager post?
faq.answer: The selection process will be based on merit, evaluated through ACRs/APARs (with an overall grading not below Very Good), followed by a Departmental Promotion Committee (DPC) review and final approval from the Ministry.

faq.question: Q7. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the post of Materials Manager (Dy. HOD) in the Chennai Port Authority Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the official website of Chennai Port Authority?
faq.answer: The official website of Chennai Port Authority is www.chennaiport.gov.in. You can visit this site for more information and to download the application form.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: This recruitment is for a Deputation job type, meaning eligible candidates will be appointed on deputation.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should I attach with the application form?
faq.answer: You should attach self-attested copies of required documents such as your photograph, signature, ID proof, and relevant educational and experience certificates as specified in the official notification.
